endpoints.screen: Appointment Detail → Charge customer (owner / front desk)
endpoints.description: The final charge at checkout (PaymentKind.CHARGE on the server), for an in_progress booking. The amount is the balance: totalAmount minus any deposit already paid. Same shape as start-booking-payment so both use one polling pattern. method 'cash': records it immediately and returns 200 with the Booking (status completed, paymentStatus paid, paymentMethod cash). method 'mpesa': sends an STK push to phone (any Kenyan format; defaults to the booking's customerPhone) routed to the business's own till/paybill/bank, and returns 202 at once. The app then polls GET /bookings/{bookingId} every 3s for up to ~2 min: success = status completed + paymentStatus paid, with paymentReference (M-Pesa receipt) and paymentMethod mpesa set; failure = chargePayment.status failed | timeout with a failureReason (same values as depositPayment). The customer can be re-prompted after a failure. No balance due (deposit covered everything): mpesa behaves like cash and completes immediately. If an M-Pesa charge lands after the booking was already paid another way (e.g. cash while the prompt was open), it's recorded as a refund owed (refund.status due). App: AppointmentDetailScreen's Charge customer sheet (src/api/booking.ts#chargeBookingPayment polls until paid or failed).

issues: REQUESTED (P1): charging requires status in_progress, but update-booking-status lets staff set completed on their own bookings. A booking completed that way can never be charged, so it stays unpaid and never counts toward earnings or commission. Please either (a) let charge-booking accept a completed booking whose paymentStatus isn't paid, or (b) stop staff (and ideally everyone) moving an unpaid booking to completed through the status endpoint. Until then the app doesn't offer staff a 'complete' action.

endpoints.description: Computed on the server from paid bookings, following the rules src/utils/earnings.ts used to apply (buckets: 3-hour for one day, daily up to 16 days, weekly up to 70, monthly beyond). from/to are business-local days, inclusive, ≤366 days apart. services lists every current service (0 rows included) plus deleted ones that earned money in the range (serviceId null). transactions: one row per service performed, newest first; transactionsLimit returns the newest N and transactionsTotal the count. Extras: currency, granularity, paidBookings, commission (the scoped person's, or everyone's), staff[] (per-person breakdown on the whole-business view), money (deposits, cancellation fees, refunds), previous (the same-length period before, with revenueChangePercent). App: hooks/useEarningsSummary on Earnings, Member Detail (staffId, only once they have one) and the staff app's Earnings; presets send transactionsLimit=10.

endpoints.description: Assigns an unassigned booking, or reassigns an assigned one.
